Oneliner

3 satellites with intersatellite link for real time interferometry and Lunar Radio Astronomy.
Description

Lunar Radio Astronomy. 3 satellite with intersatellite link for real time interferometry (now studied in SYSNOVA LUCE). SDR radio receiver for extremely low frequencies (down to 10kHz). Each satellite features three 5-meter monopole antennas. Intersatellite data transfer, ranging, time synchronization.
